evidence.reason: render_units enumerates unit templates recursively and then writes each to output/<basename>. Two source paths such as crq-repair.service and extra/crq-repair.service share the same basename, so atomic_bytes overwrites the first rendered unit with the second and paths records the same target twice. There is no duplicate-basename check before writing, so the collision is silent and only the last template's digest can be verified. This is an ordinary input-validation/correctness defect in the existing prepare behavior.
